import matplotlib
matplotlib.use('Agg')
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from matplotlib.patches import FancyBboxPatch, FancyArrowPatch

plt.rcParams.update({
    'font.family': 'DejaVu Sans',
    'font.size': 11,
    'figure.dpi': 300,
    'savefig.dpi': 300,
    'savefig.bbox': 'tight',
    'savefig.pad_inches': 0.05,
})

fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(10, 3.5))
ax.set_xlim(0, 10)
ax.set_ylim(0, 3.5)
ax.axis('off')

row_labels = [
    "Training-Associated\nExit Collapse",
    "Action-Relevant\nSensitivity",
    "Inherited Instruction-\nAttention Prior",
]
col_labels = ["Finding", "Evidence", "Limitation"]
col_colors = ['#E3F2FD', '#E8F5E9', '#FFF3E0']
col_border = ['#90CAF9', '#A5D6A7', '#FFCC80']

findings = [
    "R² drops at exit layers\nafter VLA fine-tuning",
    "Counterfactual perturbation\nreveals action-linked\nrepresentations",
    "L1 attention patterns\ninherited from\npre-trained VLMs",
]
evidences = [
    "6/6 VLM→VLA conditions\nshow Δ>0.10;\n0/4 VLA→VLA; 0/10 reference conditions",
    "Cohen’s d ≥ 0.45 across\n8 trained conditions;\nempty ranks first",
    "Reference VLMs already\nshow task-structured\nattention",
]
limitations = [
    "Correlational,\nnot causal",
    "d vs cosine metric\nincomparability",
    "Not causally\ntested",
]
cells = [findings, evidences, limitations]

label_w = 1.45
col_w = 2.45
gap_x = 0.25
cell_h = 0.85
row_gap = 0.15
top_y = 3.05
header_h = 0.35
x_start = label_w + 0.15

for j, (label, color, bc) in enumerate(zip(col_labels, col_colors, col_border)):
    x = x_start + j * (col_w + gap_x)
    y = top_y
    box = FancyBboxPatch((x, y), col_w, header_h,
                         boxstyle="round,pad=0.05", facecolor=color,
                         edgecolor=bc, linewidth=1.5)
    ax.add_patch(box)
    ax.text(x + col_w / 2, y + header_h / 2, label,
            ha='center', va='center', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold', color='#333333')

for i in range(3):
    y_row = top_y - (i + 1) * (cell_h + row_gap)

    rl_box = FancyBboxPatch((0.05, y_row), label_w, cell_h,
                            boxstyle="round,pad=0.05", facecolor='#455A64',
                            edgecolor='#37474F', linewidth=1.2)
    ax.add_patch(rl_box)
    ax.text(0.05 + label_w / 2, y_row + cell_h / 2, row_labels[i],
            ha='center', va='center', fontsize=9, fontweight='bold', color='white',
            linespacing=1.2)

    for j in range(3):
        x = x_start + j * (col_w + gap_x)
        box = FancyBboxPatch((x, y_row), col_w, cell_h,
                             boxstyle="round,pad=0.05", facecolor=col_colors[j],
                             edgecolor=col_border[j], linewidth=1.0, alpha=0.85)
        ax.add_patch(box)
        ax.text(x + col_w / 2, y_row + cell_h / 2, cells[j][i],
                ha='center', va='center', fontsize=7.5, color='#333333',
                linespacing=1.25)

    for j in range(2):
        x_from = x_start + j * (col_w + gap_x) + col_w + 0.02
        x_to = x_start + (j + 1) * (col_w + gap_x) - 0.02
        y_mid = y_row + cell_h / 2
        arrow = FancyArrowPatch((x_from, y_mid), (x_to, y_mid),
                                arrowstyle='->', mutation_scale=10,
                                color='#78909C', linewidth=1.2,
                                connectionstyle='arc3,rad=0')
        ax.add_patch(arrow)

plt.savefig('/root/vla-ssd/paper_figures/fig_claim_evidence.pdf')
plt.savefig('/root/vla-ssd/paper_figures/fig_claim_evidence.png')
plt.close()
print("DONE: fig_claim_evidence")
